bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$root"
test -d .git || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 62
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 63
test "$(gh run view 44799649562 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "af5e1146d9f1b4a02fbe5cee1ba8995778c15364 success" || exit 64
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-link-timeout-safe.XXXXXXXX)"
files=(scripts/userbot_test_client.py scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py)
for i in "${!files[@]}"; do
 f="${files[$i]}"
 test -f "$f" && test ! -L "$f" || exit $((65+i))
 cp "$f" "$tmp/old$i.py"
done
python3 - "$tmp" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
old='"link_registration_smoke", "link_rich_flow_smoke"'
new='"link_registration_smoke", "link_rich_flow_smoke", "link_photo_caption_smoke"'
for i in range(2):
 text=(root/f"old{i}.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
 if new in text:
  next_text=text
 elif text.count(old)==1:
  next_text=text.replace(old,new)
 else:
  raise SystemExit(74+i)
 target=root/f"new{i}.py"
 target.write_text(next_text,encoding="utf-8")
 compile(next_text,str(target),"exec")
PY
swapped=0
passed=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$passed" != 1; then
  for i in "${!files[@]}"; do cp "$tmp/old$i.py" "${files[$i]}" || true; done
  systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
for i in "${!files[@]}"; do cp "$tmp/new$i.py" "${files[$i]}"; done
swapped=1
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 76
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = 1 || exit 77
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 78
passed=1
echo LINK_PHOTO_IPC_TIMEOUT_FIX=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_HEALTH=PASS
